name: RealSense D455
accuracy_notes: Manufacturer nominal exterior envelope and mass; independent approximate enclosure, aperture positions, ports, mounting reference, center of mass and uniform-envelope inertia. No optical calibration, calibrated stereo baseline or simulated depth output. Nominal mass tolerance is ±10%; bulk units may omit the USB cap (approximately 2.3 g). No cable or bracket included.
status: Reference-informed detailed exterior; unmeasured component geometry
origin_description: Bottom center of total envelope; nominal attachment reference, not a measured mount interface
